method: Actual indexed runtime-loaded native source triangles. Deterministic up-to-24x24 interior vertical rays; triangle-surface contact tolerance 0.5m, terrain contact band +/-2m. Recursive same-ray source support to terrain up to six components. Additional exact 3D nearest-triangle distance from all unique native vertices within 0.35m of native minimum Y; <=0.5m component seam tolerance. No bounding-box acceptance.

rows.name: Po Lin Monastery Hall of Great Hero

limits: Open-bottom meshes make interior ray minima roof levels, not foundations. Use low-rim results separately.
Low-rim contacts do not establish connectivity of every separate ornament or triangle in a model.
Finite samples establish observed contact, not exhaustive structural stability or whole-mesh support.
Open-sided/vertical components can lack projected surface samples.
Foundation and terrain intersection require source/visual judgement.
Proposed memberships and existing holds are never approved automatically.
Supporting candidate components must be integrated together or remain held.
Surveyed fallback roof contacts reuse exact runtime extrusions with holes, require original LandsD base/top values, exclude estimated heights and self/same-CSUID contacts.
No architectural acceptance, source edits, terrain offsets, runtime writes or publication.
